notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Finally, the Prologue release day has arrived! Download and play it for free! The game will be available from 1:00 PM UTC+2 (7 AM GMT-4).
If you like the game, add the full version of Shapes & Shots to your wishlist to be the first to receive updates!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256910/Shapes__Shots/]Shapes & Shots - Complete version (Steam)[/url]
